text:
maria: Heads up — PR #6034 (allocator tweak + compacting) is ready for review. Planning to merge in the 2pm UTC window but seeing a small perf delta on the microbench. Need 2 approvals before merge.

maria: Bench snapshot (dev cluster, p95/p99, 2048 tokens):
```
baseline  -> p95: 48ms  p99: 98ms  throughput: 125 req/s  mem: 5.2GB
pr-6034   -> p95: 50ms  p99: 110ms throughput: 122 req/s  mem: 5.4GB
delta     -> p95: +2ms  p99: +12ms throughput: -2.4% mem: +200MB
```

dave: @maria can you paste the exact bench command & envoy config used? want to repro locally. also which model/shard size?

maria: command: `./bench --model gpt-medium --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --duration 300`
envoy: `route: /v1/generate -> service: runtime-canary`
shard: 4xA100-80gb equiv.

anita: I ran a quick canary on staging with same flags. I see same tail bump but only on longseq paths (seq >1024). Shorter seqs look neutral.

leo: could be KV cache alignment after the allocator change. PR touched large-slab freelist. If free list compaction causes extra memcpy on cache warmup it might hit longseq p99.

shubham: linking the diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6034/files
main change is `malloc_arena_compact` introduced and a small refactor in `alloc.cc`.

maria: @anita @dave tagging for approvals — does this delta block the merge? I can push a revert if we want to avoid the window.

dave: I can approve if we add a canary gating rule to fall back to prior allocator on >p99+10ms. Do we have feature flagging for allocator path?

leo: we do. There's `RUNTIME_ALLOC_PATH=compact|legacy` env var wired into the node startup. Deploy-bot can flip for canaries.

sre-bot: Reminder: merge window 14:00 UTC. Current time zone check: 13:12 UTC.

anita: For safety i'd prefer hold — +12ms p99 on longseq is visible for a subset of customers. We should either mitigate or do a short canary across 10 machines for 30m.

maria: ok planning: hold merge, run 10-node canary (configured with both alloc paths), compare tail over 30m, collect heap diffs. I'll kick off now.

maria: starting canary: `deploy-bot start-canary pr-6034 --nodes 10 --flags RUNTIME_ALLOC_PATH=compact`

deploy-bot: Canary started for pr-6034 on 10 nodes. health checks passing.

anita: quick heap snapshot after warmup (staging node 3):
```
before: rss: 5.1GB  malloc_total: 3.6GB  cache_usage: 1.2GB
after:  rss: 5.3GB  malloc_total: 3.8GB  cache_usage: 1.25GB
diff:   rss +200MB malloc_total +200MB cache +50MB
```

dave: thanks. running my local reproducible suite now. will report in 10-15m.

leo: a mitigation to try if confirm: reduce compaction frequency or switch compaction to async background thread so request path isn't hit. another option is to special-case >1024 seqs to use legacy path.

shubham: if background compaction is cheap to prototype we can try that in a small patch and run A/B in canary.

maria: decision: hold merge for now. testing alternatives. will post results here. if we see no customer impact after 30m with 10-node canary we may opt for a delayed merge later in the day.

dave: noted. ping me once you have 30m aggregates; i'll re-run the perf check and if it's within +5ms p99 i'll give approval.

maria: thanks all — will update in ~40m with aggregated numbers. :hourglass:
